$comment: The league tutorial (docs/leagues.md "Tutorial"), used by plugins/modes/league/Tutorial.LeagueMode.js. Every stage, interface, script and walkthrough step is from two full runs on a new character: Raging Echoes (osrs-captures 227/00196, rev 227) and Demonic Pacts (237/01098, rev 237); ids re-checked against this cache's gamevals (toplevel_osrs_stretch replaces live's toplevel_pre_eoc; chatbox:crmclose is 162:565 here). The client draws each page (title, body, buttons, picture) from the league struct's param 1033 tutorial struct, enums keyed by league_tutorial_completed; the server only moves that varbit and opens the screens.

varbits._allowMesOverlap: chatoverlay_allowmesoverlap: 1 from the welcome screen's Play while the tutorial's chat overlay is up, 0 when it ends (227/00196).

_welcomePlay: welcome_screen:play (378:72): the tutorial opens after it, as captured (227/00196), or once the new character's design closes.

screens._comment: As captured before every page: league_tutorial (653) in the toplevel's overlay_atmosphere with its click blocker noclick (653:1) shown, mesoverlay (263) in chatbox:crmclose, script 1974 with an empty line, then script 2524 (-1, -1, the modal's size) and league_tutorial_main (677) as the main modal. End Tutorial / Exit Leagues is button_1 (677:8), Get Started button_2 (677:9).

journal._comment: Stage 3 waits for the journal's side stone, stone2 on each gameframe layout (161:61, 164:54, 548:66, as plugins/areas/tutorialisland lists them; live armed OP1 on every stone at login), with flashside = 3 flashing it; stage 4 flashes the journal's Leagues tab (script 3162 with side_journal:tab_icon_5, 629:42 in this cache; 629:27 in rev 227) until the side panel (656) mounts. The side panel mounting at stage 3 counts for both.

sections._comment: A section's button on the side panel pulses (3185 on its highlight layer) while its page shows; clicking it opens the section's interface (its owner's plugin does), the pulse stops (3186) and the walkthrough runs in that interface's tutorial_highlight layer. Should nothing open the interface within `waitTicks` (its plugin is not on this server), the section is skipped so the tutorial can always be finished.

areas._unlockedVarbit: league_area_selection_1: the first area chosen beyond the starting ones (227/00196: Karamja set it to 2), so an area unlocked before the areas page counts.

tasks._comment: Completed through the task catalog's league:complete-task (#1358: tier 1, 10 points each in Trailblazer Reloaded and Raging Echoes); with no catalog on the server, paid through league:award-task with these points.

flows._comment: The stages of a league's run. `stages` maps each stage to what it waits for. `areasNeedUnlock`: Raging Echoes stays at 8 after the area walkthrough until an area is unlocked (league:area-unlocked); Demonic Pacts goes to 9 at once. Demonic Pacts' pacts section (stage 11, the pacts tree 647) runs no walkthrough: its middle step waits for a pact point to be spent in an interface this server does not have, so the button skips to stage 13.

text.text: This is the <col=ffffff>task list</col>. Here you can see all of the <col=ffffff>tasks</col> available to you in this <col=ffffff>League</col>.

Within the <col=ffffff>task list</col>, you can view more information about each <col=ffffff>task</col>, including <col=ffffff>difficulty</col> and the amount of <col=ffffff>League Points</col> awarded for completion.
There are <col=ffffff>five</col> different tiers of <col=ffffff>task difficulty</col>. The harder a <col=ffffff>task</col>, the more <col=ffffff>League Points</col> you'll earn.

Each <col=ffffff>League</col> has hundreds of <col=ffffff>tasks</col> that cover all aspects of the game. You can <col=ffffff>filter</col> the <col=ffffff>task list</col> to make it easier to find the right one for you.

You can easily keep track of your progress within the <col=ffffff>League</col> using the <col=ffffff>progress bar</col>. As you progress, you'll gain access to new <col=ffffff>unlocks</col> within the <col=ffffff>League</col> as well as new <col=ffffff>rewards</col> on your <col=ffffff>main profile</col>.
There are a lot of <col=ffffff>tasks</col> on offer during this <col=ffffff>League</col>, try and aim to complete as many as possible!
This is the <col=ffffff>Area Selection Menu</col>. Here you can unlock new <col=ffffff>areas</col> or <col=ffffff>teleport</col> to previously unlocked ones.

New <col=ffffff>areas</col> are unlocked using <col=ffffff>tasks</col>. The more <col=ffffff>tasks</col> you have completed, the more <col=ffffff>areas</col> you can unlock. The <col=ffffff>Area Selection Menu</col> can be used to easily track your progress towards the next unlock.

There are <col=ffffff>ten</col> different <col=ffffff>areas</col> in <col=ffffff>Leagues V - Raging Echoes</col>, but you can only unlock <col=ffffff>five</col> of them. Your first area, the <col=ffffff>Kingdom of Misthalin</col>, has been unlocked automatically.

To unlock additional <col=ffffff>areas</col>, you can use the <col=ffffff>Area Information Panel</col>. <col=ffffff>Clicking</col> on any <col=ffffff>area</col> will bring up the respective <col=ffffff>Area Information Panel</col>.
As well as letting you unlock new <col=ffffff>areas</col>, the <col=ffffff>Area Information Panel</col> can also be used to <col=ffffff>teleport</col> to already available <col=ffffff>areas</col>.

Now that you've completed your first <col=ffffff>task</col>, you can unlock your second <col=ffffff>area</col>! For your second <col=ffffff>area</col>, let's unlock the island of <col=ffffff>Karamja</col>. Remember, you can unlock an <col=ffffff>area</col> using the <col=ffffff>Area Information Panel</col>.
This is the <col=ffffff>Relic Selection Menu</col>. Here you can unlock powerful <col=ffffff>Relics</col> to use during this <col=ffffff>League</col>.

<col=ffffff>Relics</col> are unlocked using <col=ffffff>League Points</col>. The more <col=ffffff>League Points</col> you have, the more <col=ffffff>Relic</col> tiers available to you. There are <col=ffffff>8</col> <col=ffffff>Relic</col> tiers in total and the <col=ffffff>Relic Selection Menu</col> can be used to easily track your progress towards the next one.

Each <col=ffffff>Relic</col> tier contains <col=ffffff>up to three</col> different <col=ffffff>Relics</col>, all with unique powers. Once you've unlocked a <col=ffffff>Relic</col> tier, you can choose any <col=ffffff>Relic</col> from within it. However, you can only pick <col=ffffff>one</col> <col=ffffff>Relic</col> from each tier and you can't change your mind later.

<col=ffffff>Clicking</col> on a <col=ffffff>Relic</col>, even one from a locked tier, will bring up the <col=ffffff>Relic Information Panel</col>. From there, you can view information on that <col=ffffff>Relic</col> and, if it's available, decide if you want to unlock it.

For each <col=ffffff>Relic</col> tier you have available, you'll gain <col=ffffff>passive effects</col>. The <col=ffffff>passive effects</col> for each tier is displayed on the <col=ffffff>Relic Information Panel</col> of any <col=ffffff>Relic</col> in that tier.

The first <col=ffffff>Relic</col> tier is free so if you want, you can unlock your first <col=ffffff>Relic</col> now! If you'd rather decide later, just close the <col=ffffff>Relic Selection Menu</col> with the <col=ffffff>cross</col> in the top right corner.

walkthroughs._pacts: The pact tree's walkthrough as recorded (237/01098, talent_tree:tutorial_highlight 647:14, highlight_screen 3409 and highlight_textbox 3413): three steps, the third waiting for the central pact to be bought; the tree comes back with the last two (pactsAfter), then the next page.

leagues._comment: Which flow a league runs. Its pages are the cache's: struct param 1033 points at struct 747 for Leagues II, IV and V, whose text the rev 241 cache writes for Leagues V, so Leagues II and IV get copies of its title and body enums with their own name (`rename`) as overrides; Leagues VI's struct 6456 is its own. Twisted's struct has no tutorial, and Shattered Relics' (4131) is a different flow (its class choice, PR 5), so neither starts one.

pages._comment: The tutorial struct's params: 1034 the titles, 1035 the bodies (enums keyed by stage, strings). The overrides' ids are the league's virtual base + `virtualIdOffsets`.

welcome._comment: The welcome screen's message of the week (welcome_screen:motw, 378:6) on a league world, as captured (227/00196): the league's name and, when world.json's pluginConfig `league:end` (an ISO date) is set, the days left.
welcome.remaining: There are {days} days remaining in this League.
welcome.remainingOne: There is 1 day remaining in this League.
